intent: Floating notice after an action. Status colors the icon only. Title + optional description + dismiss.
useWhen: Transient warnings that do not need a choice
doNotUseWhen: Long forms or multi-step work — use Modal

status.note: Colors the icon only. Card stays surface-card. default is a neutral icon.

size.note: Padding only. sm is space-2/space-3, md is space-3/space-4, lg is space-4/space-5. Layout stays two rows.

action.note: Optional control under the description. Compose kit Button. Not ToastAction.

requirements: Title and description wired with ids when present

doNot: Do not invent ToastTitle, ToastDescription, ToastViewport, or ToastAction cousins
Do not use Alert for toast feedback
Do not use glass, color-mix, or backdrop-blur
snippet: <Toast title="Message sent" description="Thanks for sharing your ideas, we can explain the next steps here." status="info" onClose={() => {}} />
